notes.title: The Lacerator Dev Update
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

It's been a while since you've been updated on the progress that's been made in [i][b]The Lacerator[/b][/i], and we wanted to keep you all in the loop! Games From The Abyss has been toiling away in Max's journey, and he can't wait for you all to see what's in store (Like the new badass Key Art)!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43734692/8f59da61a2331dfc217321ff57bbc8210c234695.png[/img]

We wanted to try and do one of these occasionally to show off some environments, enemies, and weapons or just random things Fernando has made for the game. 

Meet...

[h2][b]THE MINDLESS CRAWLER[/b][/h2]

The Mindless Crawler will chase Max around the Lacerators labyrinth. Even without legs, he still has to end Max's life one way or another because if Max doesn’t finish them off, The Lacerator will rip them to shreds in his furious rage. As you can see, he has a bomb strapped to his back, which will go off when he gets close to Max. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43734692/272cfa3bdf44ff97876d237aa2133d72a24c3a37.gif[/img]

Max will have to be fast or have good aim to take these guys down before their bomb goes off! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43734692/94aa986becf259288197ba08d379c3ef6652531d.gif[/img]


We are excited to start showing off more of what goes into making [i][b]The Lacerator[/b][/i], especially as we go into launch year!
